COLLECTION A: EDUCATIONAL CREATIONS

Ten Original Educational Creations

Proprietary curricula, frameworks, and whole-brain learning systems designed and run across ACHARIYA campuses.

EXHIBIT A1Institutional Record(CLM-014)

The Dasavadani Curriculum

Ten Intelligences, One Integrated Curriculum

“A home-grown curriculum built on ten intelligences, named after the classical Indian art of multi-tasking.”

ACHARIYA's proprietary multiple-intelligence curriculum. It works with eight of Howard Gardner's intelligences, sets musical intelligence aside, and adds two of Dr. Arawindhan Ji's own: Financial Intelligence (FI) and Emotional Intelligence (EI). Beyond these sits Quantum Intelligence, which trains children as 'Suprasapiens'.

How It Works (Core Mechanics):
  • Named after Avadhanam: children progress from Panchavadhani (5 tasks) to Ashtavadhani (8) and towards Dasavadhani (10).
  • Built on a 10,000-hour training philosophy: "Avadhani to Dasavadhani".
  • Blends CBSE, ICSE, and State Board syllabi with practical life-skills practice.
★ Runs systematically across all ACHARIYA Schools, WOW Programmes, and Heguru Centres.Deep Dive
EXHIBIT A2Institutional Record(CLM-015)

The K12 Journey: From I CAN to ICON

Schooling Mapped as a Journey of Growing Speed & Independence

“From Walking to Take-off: A complete journey across Knowing, Doing, and Being.”

A comprehensive K12 educational design across three progressive domains: Knowing, Doing, and Being, delivered through MiWay, ACHARIYA's curriculum based on Multiple Intelligence theory. The 100% Learning Curve SOP takes every learner from Micro to Mastery.

How It Works (Core Mechanics):
  • Walking (Toddler–Mont 2): Fine motor skills and sensory awakening.
  • Cycling & Super-Fast Cycling (Grades 1–5): BMIT intelligence mapping, Divya practices, and finding core domain.
  • Bike Riding (Grades 6–8): ICAN foundation, innovation labs, and Career vs Life-Calling clarity.
★ ICAN foundation course active for Grades 6–9 with specialized NEET, JEE, and CA pathways.Deep Dive
EXHIBIT A3Institutional Record(CLM-016)

The Brain Activity System

Training Attention, Memory, Courage & Multi-tasking Through the Body

“Brain Activity over Ability: Marks measure recall; Brain Activity is the engine underneath.”

Dr. Arawindhan Ji's core philosophy made practical. While traditional schooling measures recall through exam marks, Brain Activity is the engine of mental muscle that can be trained through repetition, challenge, and recovery. Two children may both score 95%, but possess completely different brain architecture; ACHARIYA develops the deeper capacity.

How It Works (Core Mechanics):
  • The Five Arts: Silambam (overcoming fear of heights/dark), Malkhamb (building Thunivu / grit), Yoga, Chess, and Golden Smile Meditation.
  • The Invisible Curriculum: Ball juggling for every child, cup stacking, 40 kinds of rope knots, towel folding, and Rubik’s cube.
  • Progression from single-tasking to parallel processing to true multi-tasking.
★ 222 Guinness and World records achieved in open and blindfolded cognitive activities.Deep Dive
EXHIBIT A4Institutional Record(CLM-017)

Q-Math and Q School

“You Can Experience Maths”: The Concept is Lived Before the Technique is Taught

“A reversal of traditional mathematics pedagogy: See it, touch it, think it, solve it, apply it.”

A radical reversal of traditional rote maths teaching. Children first physically see and touch the concept, apply Vedic Maths techniques, and translate real-world sentences into equations. Q School scales this approach as ACHARIYA's EduTech division.

How It Works (Core Mechanics):
  • Five verbs executed every time: See it, touch it, think it, solve it, apply it.
  • Three 20-minute daily periods: Mental Maths, Abacus, and Quantum Computing foundations.
  • 100+ pre-maths skills taught across ten classes with an Addition Practice Board and Number Line.
★ Fluency built systematically in Classes 1–8 is applied directly in Classes 9–12 competitive exams.Deep Dive
EXHIBIT A5Institutional Record(CLM-018)

The TRACK Model of Assessment

An Exam that Records Learning Instead of Causing It — Zero Anxiety

“Assessment without anxiety: AI identifies the exact learning gap; a supplement closes it.”

A reimagined assessment architecture. Random questions and diagnostic revision tests precede formal evaluation, giving parents and teachers real-time clarity on learner comprehension. The examination ceases to be a source of fear and becomes an objective record of mastery.

How It Works (Core Mechanics):
  • Equally weighted: Practical 100% and Theory 100%.
  • Knowing → Doing → Being: Concept Applied naturally becomes genuine Understanding.
  • AI serves as a diagnostic partner in co-schooling, pinpointing specific micro-gaps.
★ Parents, children, and educators review the identical diagnostic evidence together.Deep Dive
EXHIBIT A6Institutional Record(CLM-019)

The Power Teaching Toolkit

Multi-Angle Classroom Pedagogy: Every Child Owns the Concept

“Every chapter is engaged from several cognitive angles before formal study begins.”

A family of repeatable, high-engagement classroom methods designed to bring active pedagogy into every period, every day. Moves teachers away from passive lecturing into dynamic learning facilitation.

How It Works (Core Mechanics):
  • Link & Story: The mandatory Jolly Box builds an emotional hook before textbook content arrives.
  • Power Teaching: Skim, scan, a flipping song with physical actions, and a whistle recall cue.
  • Sequence Boards: Per concept for nouns, verbs, story arc, and grammar tenses.
★ Timed reading benchmarks target at least a 10x improvement in reading speed for every student.Deep Dive
